title: RUST_CODE.BBS · The sysop
venue: Arthur's site · drawn during Message Boards · never posted
logline: A message on the board addressed to the strip: the sender's handle is the wandering one's, and the message is four lines of blocks and one legible word — the town's name, spelled the old way, the way the road sign spelled it before the county fixed it. Wood turns the monitor off. The chorus stays lit.

panels.composition: The screen: a message in green blocks, four lines, and one word legible in the last line.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a computer screen with four lines of green blocks and one legible-looking word in the last line drawn as a shape

panels.composition: The wandering stick figure on the desk, looking up at its own handle on the screen.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a tiny stick figure on a desk looking up at a green word on a screen above it

panels.composition: The monitor dark. The four stick figures on the desk faintly green in the dark.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a dark computer monitor with four tiny stick figures on the desk before it glowing faintly green

art.line: digitized brush-pen on bristol; the stick figures in ballpoint; the screen as a gray rectangle with a banner in it

notes: The word: Smolvud, the old spelling (Vol 7's town = Small Wood). As a shape. The chorus stays lit.
